free_tier.stated: USD 29.99/year for a 2 GB KVM VPS in Los Angeles or New York: 2 vCPU, 35 GB SSD, 5 TB monthly transfer, 1 Gbps port, 1 IPv4. The same table prices 4 GB at USD 59.99/year or USD 5.99/month (3 vCPU, 60 GB SSD, 8 TB), 6 GB at USD 79.99/year or USD 7.99/month (5 vCPU, 100 GB, 12 TB) and 8 GB at USD 99.99/year or USD 9.99/month (7 vCPU, 150 GB, 20 TB). The vendor's own homepage carries no 2 GB KVM row: its cheapest KVM-shaped entries are USD 9.99/month for 1 GB, 40 GB and 3 TB and USD 14.95/month for 2 GB, 60 GB and 6 TB, both on a 100 Mbps public uplink and both fully managed with cPanel included.

egress.terms: 5 TB a month on the 2 GB plan; no overage price and no post-allowance throttle stated

record.tooling: the homepage names a Virtualizor control panel and advertises cPanel/WHM on the VPS lines; no API or CLI is documented on the page read
record.chaining: USD 29.99/year is USD 2.50/month for 2 GB and 35 GB of SSD with 5 TB of transfer, which is the cheapest per-year 2 GB offer among evaluated providers; the same host sells a fully managed 2 GB with cPanel at USD 14.95/month, so the promo line is the unmanaged one and the chaining decision is whether a managed panel is worth six times the price.

limits.value: 5 TB a month on the 2 GB plan, 8 TB on the 4 GB, 12 TB on the 6 GB and 20 TB on the 8 GB, all stated per plan in the offer table.
